finalText:
**Redis died at `02:14:07` and never came back.**

`redis connection lost: ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache fell back to direct store reads. Reads then timed out under load, for 17 straight minutes. 12 reconnect attempts all failed same address.

Request queue climbed past its own cap, hit 568 against `max 500`. No backpressure kicked in. At `02:31:44` `worker-2` hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`. Supervisor restarted it, then killed the whole `api` process group at `02:31:52`.

Root cause: `10.0.0.12:6379` was unreachable the whole time.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12` went down.
